title: Es Currals Alpacas Ibiza | First Alpaca Farm & Wishfulfilling Weaving Studio
desc: Es Currals Alpacas Ibiza is the very first alpaca farm in Ibiza and is located in the rural north of the island, on an authentic finca in a beautiful natural setting. Here is also the beating heart of Wishfulfilling Weaving, the artisanal weaving studio where, using mainly alpaca wool exclusive scarves are woven by hand on a traditional wooden loom.
